name: TabGroup
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play tab bar: pair each Button with the GameObject it should show, and this handles the click wiring, panel switching, and an active/inactive tint on each tab's own button graphic. Nothing else in this toolkit does a plain horizontal tab bar — ScreenStackNavigator is a full-screen push/pop stack, AccordionPanel collapses vertically in place, CardCarousel swipes — this is the classic "click a tab, swap the panel below it" pattern none of those cover.

src_members.comment: For configuring tabs from code (a dynamically-built tab set) instead of the Inspector array — mirrors the Set*() pattern this toolkit already uses elsewhere (e.g. ScreenStackNavigator.SetRootScreen) for components more naturally wired at runtime than authored by hand.
